content: महर् (महस्) {%ind.%} .²1 The fourth of the seven worlds which rise one above the other from the earth (being between {%svar%} and {%janas%}); (महर्लोक also in this sense). .²2 A kind of व्याहृति <ab>q. v.</ab>

महस् {%n.%} [मह्-असुन्] .²1 A festival, a festive occasion. .²2 An offering, oblation, a sacrifice. .²3 Light, lustre; कल्याणानां त्वमसि महसां भाजनं विश्वमूर्ते <ls>Māl. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>U. 4. 10</ls>, <ls n="U.">5. 27</ls>. .²4 The fourth of the seven worlds; see महर्. .²5 A hymn of praise (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²6 Pleasure, enjoyment; जातमहाः स्तवनानि वसन्तः <ls>Rām. Ch. 4. 95</ls>; महोमहत्त्वं महनीयशीले विलासलोलेन विलोचनेन <ls n="Rām. Ch.">6. 12</ls>. .²7 Greatness, power. .²8 Abundance, plenty. .²9 Water.
